name: obsidian-rich-table
description: Spreadsheet-like tables in a code block: merged cells, typed columns, sort, filter and summary rows, frozen panes, multi-sheet workbooks, and Kanban or calendar views of the same rows — with full Markdown and wikilinks in every cell.

scripts.build: node esbuild.config.mjs generate && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && eslint . && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && node esbuild.config.mjs generate && git add manifest.json versions.json src/changelog/generated.ts
scripts.changelog:check: node esbuild.config.mjs generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/changelog/generated.ts
scripts.verify:ci: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('node_modules',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm ci && npm run build && npm run changelog:check && npm test
